registered: 2026-11-18 ~11:45 ET, before any tick was fetched or any flow number computed
operator: 11/18: 'Yes, run it' - can first-minute SIP order flow tell the trades that fall straight to the stop from the dips that recover?
background: loser_breakdown (running list row 142): 15% of trades never go green and hit the full stop, = 2.7x the net loss; timed never-green cuts lost in 7 versions because ~60% of dips recover (memory never-green-cut-fails-every-version). This tests a NEW signal, not a timed cut.

data.trades: broker fills ai_reports/broker_truth/fills.jsonl, round trips paired FIFO per symbol per day (tools/studies/loser_breakdown.pair_fifo), 2026-09-16..2026-11-18, desk-off days 11/12-11/16 excluded, entry 09:31-15:45
data.ticks: SIP trades for the traded symbol from 5 s before the buy fill to 120 s after (data-only account), cached

signal.flow_W: tick-rule signed volume from the fill to fill + W s (uptick = buy, downtick = sell, zero tick = previous sign): (buy - sell) / (buy + sell); W in {60, 120}
signal.below_W: last SIP trade at fill + W below the buy fill price

rule: at fill + W, if the trade is still open, below_W, and flow_W <= K: sell at the last SIP trade at fill + W minus 3 bp (half the spread, memory never-greens-are-not-entry-cost). Otherwise keep the actual broker exit.
comparison: PLAIN = the same rule without the flow condition (the tested never-green cut). FLOW must beat PLAIN as well as holding.

split.train: trades with entry day <= 2026-10-23 - choose W and K from the grid W {60, 120} x K {-0.2, -0.4, -0.6} by book delta (bp per trade over all train trades)
split.test: trades with entry day >= 2026-10-26 - the chosen (W, K) only, scored once

pass_if_ALL (test).book: mean delta per trade (rule exit - actual exit, 0 for untouched trades) >= +1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL (test).significance: day-clustered t of the per-day mean delta >= 2.0
pass_if_ALL (test).beats_plain: FLOW book delta >= PLAIN book delta + 1.0 bp
pass_if_ALL (test).both_halves: train book delta of the chosen (W, K) > 0

information: share of full stop-outs (<= -40 bp) the rule cuts vs share of later winners it cuts
flow_W distribution for straight-to-stop trades vs recovering dips
AUC of flow_W for straight-to-stop among trades below entry at W
after_pass: build the exit behind a switch (default off) in ai_positions using the live SIP/IEX trade stream; under the operator's 11/18 rule a PASS ships (paper), judged by broker truth
else: do not build a flow exit; the straight-to-stop trades stay unexplained
caveats: fills span several desk configs (stops, entry rules) - the rule is judged on its own delta per trade, which is config-neutral as long as the actual exit is later than W; tick rule, not quotes; the live desk sees IEX, not SIP, ticks
